paragraphs.text: Pi and DSH plugins for stock market
# Sparkles

Read-only finance evidence tools for two coding-agent hosts:
Pi in the terminal and
DeepSeek Harness

(DSH) in
the browser. Both distributions reuse the same Gleam functional cores while
keeping host r

egistration, session ownership, presentation, packaging, and
release maturity separate.

The Pi and DSH distributions are independently ProductUseful T1–T6 releases
covering the same 135 le

dger components through separate host-native
entrypoints. No component can place, route, cancel, rep

lace, or otherwise
mutate a paper or live order.
| Host | npm package | Host-native output | Release state |
| Pi | `@pi-sparkles/pi-sparkles` | terminal components, including responsive colored Unicode OHLCV

charts | Published · ProductUseful T1–T6 |
| DSH | `@dsh-sparkles/dsh-sparkles` | browser slots, ses
sion projections, and floating SVG OHLCV charts | Published 0.1.18 · ProductUseful T1–T6 |

The seven packages excluded from the aggregate (`hello`, `lifecycle`,
`safety_gate`, `cn_setup`, `hk

_setup`, `cn_fundamentals`, `hk_fundamentals`)
are development extras, not extra products.

Package-level Experimental labels are inventory. ProductUseful applies only to
a whole role tier. Ti

ers are not a 6×3 track matrix. See
PRODUCT_TIERS.md.

The DSH distribution mounts 131 global-safe shells plus per-agent counterparts for
track status, swi

ng workbench, portfolio, and watchlist. Its finance track
status and vertically stacked OHLCV charts

share DSH's browser `shell.overlay`.
Drag the status bar to move the group; hide/show each chart se

parately. See
dsh/README.md.

DSH also provides opt-in, session-owned saved picks and bounded recurring
reviews through its native
storage runner. See DSH recurring pick reviews.
## Remember personal picks with Pi Durable

When you use a watchlist, Sparkles gives the LLM an option to offer: “Shall I
remember these picks a

cross chats?” Accept in conversation; no command-line
opt-in is needed. Storage and checks stay off

until you accept. The default
private store is `~/.pi-sparkles-watchlist`; accepted stores reopen wi

you accept. The default
private store is `~/.pi-sparkles-watchlist`; accepted stores reopen with Pi.

Saving picks is separate from scheduling. You can ask for one review or choose
an interval and bound

ed count of recurring reviews. CN checks reuse the explicit
Eastmoney A-share source and its runtime

`AGENT_CONTACT` requirement. HK/US
picks are saved, but their scheduled checks are labelled `track_

partial`.
Checks run while Pi is open. Inspect results through conversation; failures and
interrupte

d calls are unknown, with no automatic refetch or external alerts.
See watchlist for controls and li

ls are unknown, with no automatic refetch or external alerts.
See watchlist for controls and limits.

Try: “My picks are CN 600519 and CN 600000.” If Pi offers to remember them,
reply “Yes, remember the

se picks across chats.” In another chat, ask to show
the saved watchlist or review it once using Eas

tmoney A-share quotes. Pi Durable
follows Pi's release version: this checkout bundles Durable, Chord

and Pi AI
1.5.0 to match the tested Pi 1.5.0 host. They initialize after opt-in; DSH uses
its nativ
e per-session watchlist storage and review runner.

## Develop

Requirements: Gleam and Bun, plus the host used by the lane being tested:
either a hydrated Pi check

out or installed `pi`, and installed `dsh` for DSH
runtime verification.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`test:aggregate:pi` loads the cumulative T1–T6 entrypoint once. Per-plugin and
earlier-tier Pi-load

targets are not part of verification. It uses
`PI_SOURCE_DIR` when that checkout has its dependencie

s, defaults to
`/home/kaiwu/Documents/github/pi-mono` in this workspace, and falls back to the
insta

lts to
`/home/kaiwu/Documents/github/pi-mono` in this workspace, and falls back to the
installed Pi.
Focused diagnostics stay cheap; promotion is always a whole tier:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Opt-in live lanes are excluded from `bun run test`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Packaging: `bun run tier:package -- T1`, `bun run aggregate:build` (T6 means
T1–T6; pass `T5` only t

o reproduce the prior boundary), `bun run npm:pack`,
`bun run npm:release:verify`. Details in NPM_RE

LEASE.md and
PRODUCT_TIERS.md.

Hex still distributes Gleam **source**, not a loadable Pi plugin, and is not
the user-facing product
. `pi_gleam` is an unpublished `0.1.0` binding.
## Runtime environment

Set variables in the environment that launches Pi or DSH. This repository does
not load `.env` files
. Restart the selected host after changes.
| Variable | Kind | Used by |

| `AGENT_CONTACT` | non-secret operator identity | every CN/HK/US adapter and the statusline |
| `TU

SHARE_TOKEN` | credential | CN symbol discovery and Tushare-backed event tools |
